statement: For every cubic E_d:X³+Y³=dZ³ with rational infinity origin, nontorsion R∈E_d(Q), and the actual joint compact/j-line level-three quotient, any pure coefficient-three alteration of any integer n has a Selmer lift exactly when it equals n.
